info.name: Codevibe Sign HTTP API
info.description:
Send documents for signature, sign them, seal the PDF and verify it.

Generated from the OpenAPI document. Set `baseUrl` and `apiKey` first.

item.name: Envelopes
item.description: Create, change, send and withdraw envelopes. Sender API key required.

query.description: Case-insensitive text anywhere in the title.

request.description:
List envelopes

The caller's workspace's envelopes, newest first, one page at a time. Pass the
`nextCursor` of a page as `cursor` to get the next one. Each row is a summary without
fields or values; get the envelope for those.

header.description:
Any unique string, up to 255 characters. A retry with the same key and body within
24 hours returns the first response. The same key with a different body is a
`VALIDATION` error; while the first request is still running, `CONFLICT`.

request.description:
Create an envelope

Creates a draft with its documents, recipients and fields, and sends it at once when
`send` is `true`. Send the PDFs either as base64 in JSON, or as a multipart upload with
the envelope JSON in a form field named `envelope` and the files as `documents`.

The example carries a real one-page PDF, so it works as it is in Test Request.

Each PDF is checked: at most 20 MB by default, at most 20 per envelope, and it must
open as a PDF. Field boxes are in PDF points from the top-left corner of the page and
must fit on it.

header.description:
Any unique string, up to 255 characters. A retry with the same key and body within
24 hours returns the first response. The same key with a different body is a
`VALIDATION` error; while the first request is still running, `CONFLICT`.

request.description:
Create an envelope

Creates a draft with its documents, recipients and fields, and sends it at once when
`send` is `true`. Send the PDFs either as base64 in JSON, or as a multipart upload with
the envelope JSON in a form field named `envelope` and the files as `documents`.

The example carries a real one-page PDF, so it works as it is in Test Request.

Each PDF is checked: at most 20 MB by default, at most 20 per envelope, and it must
open as a PDF. Field boxes are in PDF points from the top-left corner of the page and
must fit on it.

Get an envelope

The envelope with its documents, recipients, fields and the values entered so far.

Change a draft

Changes a draft envelope. Only the properties you send change. `recipients` and
`fields`, when sent, replace the whole list: pass a recipient's `id` to keep it (its
signing order and details are updated), leave it out to remove it. Fields name their
recipient by `key` or `id` and their document by `id` or position (`"0"`).
Documents cannot be changed; create a new envelope instead. Send `"message": null`
to remove the message.

header.description:
Any unique string, up to 255 characters. A retry with the same key and body within
24 hours returns the first response. The same key with a different body is a
`VALIDATION` error; while the first request is still running, `CONFLICT`.

request.description:
Send a draft

Sends the draft. In sequential routing the recipients with the lowest `order` get their
signing links; in parallel routing everyone does. Viewers get a copy once it is complete.
The envelope needs at least one signer or approver, and every signer needs a signature
field.

header.description:
Any unique string, up to 255 characters. A retry with the same key and body within
24 hours returns the first response. The same key with a different body is a
`VALIDATION` error; while the first request is still running, `CONFLICT`.

request.description:
Withdraw an envelope

Withdraws a sent envelope that is not yet final. Signing links stop working and
recipients already invited are told it was withdrawn.

header.description:
Any unique string, up to 255 characters. A retry with the same key and body within
24 hours returns the first response. The same key with a different body is a
`VALIDATION` error; while the first request is still running, `CONFLICT`.

request.description:
Remind recipients

Mails a reminder with a fresh signing link to everyone whose turn it is, or to the one
recipient named. Each recipient gets at most one reminder or invitation every 15
minutes; manual reminders do not count against the automatic ones.

item.name: Audit and files
item.description: The audit log, the certificate, and the original and sealed PDFs.

request.description:
Audit log

Every action on the envelope, oldest first, and whether the hash chain is intact: each
event's `hash` is `sha256(prevHash + canonical(event))` and the last one must equal the
envelope's `auditHead`.

query.description: `original`, or `sealed` (fails with `INVALID_STATE` until sealing has finished).

request.description:
Download a PDF

The sealed PDF once the envelope is complete, otherwise the original. Ask for one of
them with `version`.

Verify the sealed PDF

Runs the seal check on the stored sealed file against the operator certificate and any
older certificates the server trusts.

Signing certificate

What the certificate page of the sealed PDF shows, as JSON: the hash of each document
before and after sealing, each recipient with the authentication they used and every
action they took, and the head of the audit chain.

item.name: Signing
item.description:
What the recipient's browser calls. `{token}` is the signing token from the link,
or the literal `link` to use the token held in the `cvsign_link` cookie.

header.description: For recipients who sign with a one-time code, after otp/verify.

variable.description:
The signing token from the link (43 base64url characters), or `link` to use the
token in the `cvsign_link` cookie. Anything else is refused with `TOKEN_INVALID`.

request.description:
Open a signing session

The envelope basics, the recipient, their own fields and values, and what they still
need to do. For recipients who sign with a one-time code, `otpRequired` is `true` and
`authenticated` says whether a valid session came with the request. `canAct` is
`false` while it is someone else's turn.

request.description:
Download the original PDF

The document to sign. Recipients who sign with a one-time code must verify it first.

request.description:
Send a one-time code

Sends a new six-digit code by email or SMS, valid for 10 minutes, and replaces the
previous one. At most 5 codes per 15 minutes and 10 per recipient over the envelope's
life; after that the answer is `OTP_LOCKED` with `details.reason: "too_many_codes"`
and the sender has to send the envelope again.

header.description:

variable.description:
The signing token from the link (43 base64url characters), or `link` to use the
token in the `cvsign_link` cookie. Anything else is refused with `TOKEN_INVALID`.

request.description:
Verify the one-time code

Checks the code. On success the server sets a 30-minute `cvsign_session` cookie
(HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, path `/v1/sign`) and also returns the session, which you
can send as `X-Sign-Session` instead. Five wrong guesses lock the code (`OTP_LOCKED`);
ask for a new one.

Record that the document was opened

Marks the recipient as having viewed the document. Call it when the page shows the
document, not when the link is opened, so mail scanners that follow links change
nothing.

request.description:
Sign or approve

Submits the recipient's field values and their consent to sign electronically. Signers
must fill every required field; approvers send an empty `values` list. When the last
required recipient acts, the envelope completes and the sealed PDF is produced.

request.description:
Decline

Declines to sign. The envelope becomes `declined` and everyone already invited is told.

variable.description: The signing token from the email.

request.description:
Open a signing link

Where signing links point. Stores the token in an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict
`cvsign_link` cookie (path `/v1/sign`, at most 24 hours) and redirects to the signing
page, whose URL carries no token. The page then calls `/v1/sign/link/...` from the same
origin. An unknown or used token clears the cookie and redirects all the same. This
route only reads: opening a link does not mark the document as viewed.

Health check

Answers as long as the process serves requests. It does not touch the store.

This document

The OpenAPI 3.1 description of this server's API. Public and cacheable: send the
`ETag` back as `If-None-Match` to get `304 Not Modified` while it is unchanged.
